requirements.summary: Kwale County Government seeks the design, development and implementation of a County Investment Dashboard (Projects Monitoring System). The system will monitor and report on county investment projects.

sections.title: Experience – Similar Magnitude System Development
sections.guidance: Provide details of at least two previous ICT system development projects of similar nature and magnitude (KES 3 million+ or comparable), including award letters, contracts, completion certificates or user acceptance reports.

sections.title: Methodology – Work Plan and Technical Approach
sections.guidance: Present a work plan schedule indicating timelines and key deliverables, and describe the technical approach, design methodology and models to be used.

sections.title: Key Personnel/Experts – Project Leader, System Developer, Programmer/Tester
sections.guidance: Attach academic certificates, CVs and reference letters for each key person. Detail experience levels as per scoring matrix (Project Leader up to 10 points, System Developer up to 5 points, Programmer/Tester up to 5 points).

submission: Physical submission to: Attention: MEBAKARI MWATABU, PUBLIC SERVICE AND ADMINISTRATION, OFFICE OF THE CHIEF OFFICER, P.O BOX 4 -80403, KWALE, KENYA
documents_required: Power of attorney (duly filled, valid and commissioned)
evaluation_criteria: Preliminary level – registration, tax compliance, bid security, completeness of forms, affidavits, trade licence, proof of hosting space, liquidity letter and serialization (disqualifying criteria – must be satisfied).
Technical Level – Experience – up to 20 points
Technical Level – Methodology – Work Plan Schedule (5 points) and Technical Approach (5 points) – total 10 points
Technical Level – Key Personnel – Project Leader (up to 10 points), System Developer (up to 5 points), Programmer/Tester (up to 5 points) – total 20 points
